hooks.command: F=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; git check-ignore -q "$F" 2>/dev/null && exit 0; case "$F" in "$R"/*.py) "$R"/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check --fix --unfixable F401,F841 --force-exclude "$F" >/dev/null 2>&1; "$R"/.venv/bin/python -m ruff format --force-exclude "$F" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; "$R"/*.md) "$R"/.venv/bin/python -m ruff format --force-exclude "$F" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0

F=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; case "$F" in "$R"/src/*.py) OUT=$(cd "$R" && .venv/bin/python -m mypy src/ 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | tail -20 >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac; exit 0

CMD=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'rm\s+-(rf|fr)\s+/(\s|\*|$|;)|rm\s+-(rf|fr)\s+\*|rm\s+-(rf|fr)\s+\.|rm\s+-(rf|fr)\s+~'; then echo '❌ BLOCKED: rm -rf with dangerous target. Specify exact paths.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

CMD=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); SEGS=$(printf '%s
' "$CMD" | grep -oE '(^|[^[:alnum:]_.-])git([[:space:]]+(-[Cc]|--git-dir|--work-tree|--namespace|--config-env|--attr-source)[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+-[^[:space:]]+)*[[:space:]]+push([[:space:]][^;&|<>]*)?($|[;&|<>)])'); [ -n "$SEGS" ] || exit 0; printf '%s
' "$SEGS" | while IFS= read -r S; do printf '%s
' "$S" | grep -qE '[[:space:]](--force(-with-lease)?|--mirror|--all|-[[:alnum:]]*f[[:alnum:]]*)([=[:space:]]|$|[;&|<>)])|[[:space:]]\+[^[:space:]]|([[:space:]]|:)(refs/heads/)?(main|master)([[:space:]]|$|[;&|<>)])' && exit 2; CD=$(printf '%s
' "$S" | awk '{ d = "."; for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) { if ($i == "-C" && i < NF) d = $(i + 1); if ($i == "push") break }; print d }'); REFS=$(printf '%s
' "$S" | awk '{ sub(/[;&|<>)]+$/, ""); p = 0; for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) if ($i == "push") { p = i; break }; r = 0; for (j = p + 1; j <= NF; j++) { if ($j == "-o" || $j == "--push-option" || $j == "--repo" || $j == "--receive-pack" || $j == "--exec") { j++; continue }; if (substr($j, 1, 1) == "-") continue; r++; if (r > 1) print $j } }'); printf '%s
' "$REFS" | while IFS= read -r T; do case "$T" in ""|*:*) ;; *) case "$(git -C "$CD" rev-parse --symbolic-full-name "$T" 2>/dev/null)" in refs/heads/main|refs/heads/master) exit 2 ;; esac ;; esac; done || exit 2; case "$(git -C "$CD" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)" in main|master) [ -z "$REFS" ] && case "$S" in *--tags*) ;; *) exit 2 ;; esac ;; esac; :; done || { echo '❌ BLOCKED: Direct push to main or force push. Create a feature branch and PR.' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0

F=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$F" in /*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; D=${F%/*}; while [ -n "$D" ] && [ ! -d "$D" ]; do D=${D%/*}; done; D=${D:-/}; [ "$(git -C "$D" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)" = main ] || exit 0; P=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$P" ] && [ "$(git -C "$D" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)" != "$P" ] && exit 0; T=${F#"$D"/}; if [ "$(git -C "$D" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null)" = true ]; then git -C "$D" check-ignore -q -- "$T" 2>/dev/null && exit 0; case "$(git -C "$D" rev-parse --show-prefix 2>/dev/null)$T" in AGENTS.md|CLAUDE.md) exit 0 ;; esac; fi; echo '❌ BLOCKED: Cannot edit repo files on main. Allowed: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md. Create a feature branch, or edit the copy in your worktree.' >&2; exit 2

CMD=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s\n' "$CMD" | grep -qE '(^|[^[:alnum:]_.-])git([[:space:]]+(-[Cc]|--git-dir|--work-tree|--namespace|--config-env|--attr-source)[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+-[^[:space:]]+)*[[:space:]]+commit([[:space:]]|$|[;&|)<>])'; then R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; OUT=$(cd "$R" && .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check --output-format concise . 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | tail -20 >&2; echo '❌ BLOCKED: Unformatted files. Run just fix, re-add the files you are committing, then retry.' >&2; exit 2; }; fi; exit 0

IN=$(cat); STOP_ACTIVE=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false'); if [ "$STOP_ACTIVE" = "true" ]; then exit 0; fi; RESPONSE=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | jq -r '.last_assistant_message // empty' | tail -200); if printf '%s\n' "$RESPONSE" | grep -qiE 'TODO|FIXME|will implement later|placeholder|stub'; then echo '⚠️ Response contains incomplete markers (TODO/FIXME/placeholder). Consider finishing before stopping.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
